brief:
Gaza's health ministry reported that Israeli attacks killed 1,574 Palestinians since the 2025 ceasefire took effect, Middle East Eye reported. In the past 24 hours alone, six Palestinians were killed and 38 wounded in Israeli strikes, according to the ministry.

The deaths occurred during the period designated as a ceasefire, with Israeli operations continuing to cause casualties throughout the truce.
dek: Israel killed 1,574 Palestinians since 2025 ‘ceasefire’, Gaza ministry says Israeli attacks killed six Palestinians and wounded 38 over the past 24 hours, Gaza’s health ministry said.
title: Israel kills 1,574 Palestinians since ceasefire began, Gaza says
